room: The forest path narrows into shadow. Twisted roots cross the trail and the air smells of damp moss and old smoke.
A rough-hewn track at the wood's edge. The trees lean inward; somewhere ahead, a stream rattles over stones.
Bracken closes in on either side. Hoofprints, days old, vanish into the dark of the trees.
pre: A {enemies[0].name} skitters out from beneath the roots and bares its teeth.
Movement in the leaves — a {enemies[0].name} drops onto the trail in front of you.
You hear claws on bark. A {enemies[0].name} circles in from the side.
post: The path ahead clears. Something else is watching from deeper in.
Silence. You wipe your hands on your robe and continue.
The forest exhales. A crow lifts off, far away, then nothing.

room: A ruined stone archway, half-swallowed by ivy. The keystone bears a sigil — a stag and tower — worn nearly smooth.
What was a gatehouse is now four crumbling pillars and a wedge of ivy. The wind here smells of old paper.
An arch that once announced a kingdom. The stones still try.
pre: A {enemies[0].name} hisses from behind the archway and lunges.
Out of the ivy lurches a {enemies[0].name}, eyes flat and bright.
post: The archway is quiet again. A few flakes of mortar drift down.
You stand panting beneath the arch. The ivy stirs, then is still.

room: The trail dips into a sour-smelling marsh. Reeds taller than a man flank the only passable path.
Black water on both sides of a narrow causeway. Insects cloud the surface and disperse.
The reeds rattle dryly. Somewhere, frogs go silent at once.
pre: The reeds part — a {enemies[0].name} bursts toward you in a spray of muck.
A {enemies[0].name} explodes out of the marsh water, spitting weeds and venom.
post: The reeds settle. Frogsong returns somewhere far off.
The marsh resumes its slow breathing. You squelch onward.

room: Small goblin camp at the edge of a moss-eaten clearing. Embers pop in a stone-ringed firepit; a half-eaten haunch turns slowly on a spit.
A clutch of crude tents, stitched from old kingdom banners. The stag-and-tower is upside down on every one.
Cookfire smoke and the smell of bad meat. Bones cracked for marrow lie in a careless pile.
pre: A bunch of goblins sit calmly around the campfire. They notice you, jump to their feet, and attack.
Around the fire, a {enemies[0].name} is mid-laugh when it sees you. The laugh turns into a war-cry.
A {enemies[0].name} drops the bone it was gnawing and bares its teeth.
post: All enemies lie sprawled around the dying fire. The spit creaks once, twice, then stops.
The camp is yours. The fire pops once, mournfully, and gutters.

room: A ruined cottage, roof caved in. Goblins have nailed crude shutters over the windows and left an offering of bones at the threshold.
What was once a farmer's house. The hearth is cold; the walls are scribbled with goblin marks in old soot.
The cottage door hangs by one hinge. Inside, somebody made a bed of rags on the dead family's table.
pre: A {enemies[0].name} slams the shutter open, crossbow already swinging.
From inside the cottage, a {enemies[0].name} screeches and charges.
The door bangs and a {enemies[0].name} comes through with knife raised.
post: Quiet returns to the cottage. A wind moves through the broken roof.
You stand in the dead house among new dead. The hearth is still cold.

room: A goblin palisade — sharpened stakes lashed across the path. Smoke from a watchfire curls past it.
The path narrows to a chokepoint between two leaning walls of pointed wood. Drums beat lazily somewhere behind it.
Stakes, ropes, hides — a fortification thrown up in days and held for years. Bones decorate the gateposts.
pre: A {enemies[0].name} drops down from the palisade with a ragged howl.
The drums stop. A {enemies[0].name} kicks open the gate and runs at you.
From the watchpost a {enemies[0].name} swings out on a rope, blade already moving.
post: The drums do not start again. You step over the bodies into the silence beyond.
The gate hangs open. Smoke drifts past you, finally going somewhere.

room: A long gallery lined with stone effigies of dead Eldarmark kings. Each one wears a half-broken crown carved into the stone.
Royal tombs in two quiet rows. Dust on the floor is undisturbed except where something heavy dragged itself toward the back.
Carved kings in pairs, hands folded. Some of the hands have been chipped away — recently.
pre: Stone scrapes on stone — a {enemies[0].name} steps from between two effigies.
A {enemies[0].name} rises slowly from where it had been kneeling at a king's feet.
The dust shifts. A {enemies[0].name} resolves out of the gloom between two carved tombs.
post: The kings stare past you, indifferent. Dust settles on the new dead among their old stones.
Quiet returns. One effigy's outstretched hand has fallen to the floor; you don't know if it was you.

room: A sunken vault chamber. Water drips from the ceiling and pools around a broken sarcophagus in the center.
Bones in heaps along the walls. The vault's iron doors stand half-open, prised long ago by something not gentle.
A flooded crypt-floor reflects torchlight from above. Shapes shift just below the water that aren't fish.
pre: Water sloshes — a {enemies[0].name} wades out from behind the sarcophagus.
From the bone-pile, a {enemies[0].name} unfolds itself.
A {enemies[0].name} rises from the flooded floor, weed-tangled, grinning.
post: The dripping resumes. Whatever else is down here doesn't move.
You climb back out of the vault. The iron doors creak closed behind you of their own weight.

room: A vaulted chamber lined with stained tables and shattered glass. An old alchemist's workshop, abandoned mid-experiment.
Broken vials underfoot crunch into greenish powder. Something acrid still clings to the air after centuries.
Long tables, low stools, jars stacked to the ceiling — most cracked, some still leaking slow, dark fluids.
pre: A {enemies[0].name} oozes between the table legs toward you.
Glass crunches — a {enemies[0].name} shoulders out of an upturned alembic.
From a shadowed corner, a {enemies[0].name} steps forward, dragging old chains.
post: The acrid air seems to thin. The jars stop their slow drip for a moment, then resume.
You leave the workshop. Centuries of unfinished work go on without you.

room: The largest crypt-chamber of the kingdom. The Goblin Chief has made it his court — a stolen throne of broken stone, bones piled like trophies.
A vaulted hall lined with smashed effigies. At its end, a heap of skulls forms a crude dais. The chief sits there, paper crown perched lopsided.
What was once a great royal hall. The dead kings' tombs have been broken open and used for furniture.
pre: The Goblin Chief stands, raises his axe, and bellows at you across the hall.
{enemies[0].name} grins and steps off the dais. The stones around him cease their shifting and watch.
{enemies[0].name} lifts the paper crown, sets it square, and raises a notched axe in both hands.
post: The paper crown lies in ash. The throne of broken stone is empty again.
Silence in the hall. You stand among bone-piles that no longer mean anything.

room: The Hoard. Gold piled to the cavern's roof — coins, plates, twisted royal regalia. Half-buried in the heap, dull beside the gold, the Crown of Eldarmark.
Heat rolls off the cavern walls. Bones of dead heroes and dead beasts mingle in the gold like sediment.
The dragon's lair. Treasure ankle-deep, then knee-deep, then to the chest. The crown is in there somewhere.
pre: {enemies[0].name} uncoils on its hoard, smoke trickling from its nostrils as it sees you.
{enemies[0].name} opens one slow, immense eye. The cavern goes very still.
The mountain of gold shifts. {enemies[0].name} lifts its head, deliberate, and looks at you.
post: {enemies[0].name} falls. Gold cascades from its body like a slow tide. Half-buried, the crown is waiting.
The cavern is silent except for the slow chime of cooling coins. The crown gleams dully in the heap, unburied at last.

room: A wayside altar at a fork in the path. The stag-and-tower of Eldarmark is carved deep enough to outlast even goblins.
Stones laid in a small ring. Old offerings — a child's beads, a soldier's button — still in the cracks.
A roadside altar of the old kingdom, half-toppled. The goblins have used it for butchering; the stone is dark with old blood, but the sigil holds.
An altar that has not been honoured in a long time. Someone has scratched goblin marks across the royal sigil — and someone else has scrubbed them out.
A small chapel set into the crypt wall. The dead kings' faces are kept here in painted wood, candles long out.
An old shrine kept warm by no one for a very long time. The sigil here is gilded and the gilt has not flaked.
A forester's cache, dug into the roots of a great oak. Whoever stocked it didn't come back.
An iron-banded box hidden under wet leaves. The lock is rusted through; the contents are not.
A pile of stolen goods stashed beneath the floorboards of a goblin shack. The looters are not here.
Sacks tied at the neck, kicked under a cot. Whatever the goblins took from the kingdom, some of it is here.
A side-vault, unsealed. Whatever was buried here has been picked through, but not entirely.
An offering chamber. The grave-goods of a minor noble lie scattered; some still have their gilt.
A wayside hermit's wagon, shutters propped open into a counter. He nods at you and gestures at his wares.
An old man at a campfire by the road. He has set out a row of vials and small charms on a folded cloth.
A roadwarden's pony-cart, parked between two trees that lean conspiratorially. He doesn't smile, but he's open for business.
A trader at a small clearing, dagger across his knees. He raises a hand to you — half greeting, half warning.
A wandering scholar has set up at a tomb-niche, table laid with charms and inks. He looks more frightened of his own customers than of the crypts.
An academic gone too deep, surrounded by his own salvage. He'd rather sell some of it than carry it back.
A clearing in the trees. The light is wrong; the leaves don't move quite right.
An overgrown path between two listing oaks. Something has been here recently.
pre: A {enemies[0].name} steps into your way and shows its teeth.
From the brush, a {enemies[0].name} resolves and charges.
post: Quiet returns. You wipe your blade and walk on.
The clearing empties around you. The leaves go back to almost-still.

scene.room: A wider chamber. Heavier footprints in the dust. Whatever's ahead is bigger than the rest.
scene.pre: Something larger than the rest stirs at the back of the room and turns to face you.
scene.post: The big one falls. The room exhales.

scene.room: A cavern at the heart of the old kingdom. The walls are warm.
scene.pre: Something old and immense lifts its head and looks at you.
scene.post: The thing falls. The walls cool slowly.

room: A pocket of quiet. An old altar, the carving worn down to a suggestion.
A small clearing. Something has been kept holy here a long time.

scene.room: A hidden stash. Old goods left for someone who never came back.
A small wayside trader. A row of wares set out on cloth, a watchful set of eyes behind it.
The path turns strange here. Something asks to be noticed.
